about: A published place observes the receipts its release carries: the set the fold keeps, B's receiptsOf, under the digest its root line names, and never the page it ships. A release renders its pages over that place, and its clone reads the same set back from its store, so a page renders the same in the tree and in the clone at whatever resolution the receipts view names.
